opportunities.title: 22 Years in Hiding: The PostgreSQL Bug That Was Always There
opportunities.why_now: PostgreSQL just patched 52 flaws, including an authenticated RCE bug that sat undetected for over two decades — a perfect case study in why 'stable' software isn't 'safe' software.
opportunities.angle: CVE deep-dive: timeline of how the bug persisted, who's affected, patch priority ranking against the other 51 flaws

opportunities.title: North Korea's $400M Deepfake Heist: Video Calls Are the New Phishing Email

opportunities.angle: Threat actor profile: how the deepfake-call vector worked step by step, plus a defensive checklist for finance/crypto teams on verifying video identity

opportunities.title: SignDrop: Nightmare Eclipse's Windows Zero-Day Nobody Patched in Time
